subject: maths
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 5 days. B alone can do the same work in 10 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B can complete work in 5 days

B alone can complete work in 10 days

A has to complete double work

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time
